prompt.text: Locked camera. A young, slim, petite woman with a platinum-blonde chin-length bob, warm-coloured tattoos on her throat and upper chest and a small white flower pendant, in a black tailored blazer over a cream V-neck top sits at a green table with a black card shoe fixed at the right of the picture, both hands resting on the felt. She waits calmly at her table: she breathes, blinks and looks gently around, and ends exactly in the pose she started in, as in the last image. Her hands stay where they are; nothing is dealt and the yellow card stays seated in the shoe. About half a second in she takes one slow, deep breath through her nose with her lips closed: her chest and shoulders rise gently, then sink as she breathes out, and she blinks once. From the third second she is back in the first pose and holds still to the end. Nothing of this happens: a second card appears, a finger passes through the card, the card grows or shrinks on its way, a hand hovers in the air without holding or laying anything, the shoe changes, the picture cuts or the camera moves.
